title: Directional Lensing Residuals at Cluster Merger Shock Fronts
abstract: Pre-registered observational pipeline to test for a directional asymmetry in lensing convergence residuals across galaxy cluster merger shock fronts. It defines a locally normalized estimator Asig using a rotation null to isolate shock-locked signals and fits a mass+gas-pressure model outside the shock aperture to avoid circularity. Mock Bullet Cluster analogues show correct sign separation between EFC-like and ΛCDM cases with zero false positives, and the pipeline is ready for JWST κ-maps combined with Chandra thermodynamics.
